description: Bicycle Maintenance Stands DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Locations of bicycle maintenance stands within the Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council administrative area. Data provided by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. CSV, GeoJSON and Shapefile datasets of Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown's Bicycle bicycle maintenance stands. Fields include: ITM coordinates, covered, number of stands, owner and confirmed. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, DLRCC, Transport and Infrastructure, bicycle, bike. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
